Backend: GET /api/accounting/period-summary filters by date_from and date_to params correctly
Backend: GET /api/accounting/period-summary returns zeros for empty date ranges
Backend: GET /api/accounting/period-summary requires authentication (returns 401/403 without token)
Backend: GET /api/accounting/payments accepts date_from and date_to params
Backend: GET /api/accounting/payments filters results by date range correctly
Backend: GET /api/accounting/expenses accepts date_from and date_to params
Backend: GET /api/accounting/expenses filters results by date range correctly
Backend: GET /api/accounting/debtors accepts date_from and date_to params
Backend: GET /api/accounting/debtors returns correct summary structure (morosos_count, al_dia_count, total_debt)
Backend: Period summary total_income matches sum of paid payments in same period
Frontend: Date range filter bar appears on Ingresos tab with Desde/Hasta pickers
Frontend: Date range filter bar appears on Egresos tab with same design
Frontend: Date range filter bar appears on Morosos page with same design
Frontend: Summary cards (3) appear on Ingresos tab - Ingresos del periodo (green), Total Adeudado (orange), Total General (dark blue)
Frontend: Summary cards appear on Egresos tab with same design
Frontend: Summary cards appear on Morosos page with same design
Frontend: Default dates are current month (2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31)
